data.one_liner: A clone of the official video_player plugin with video caching support for Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: It plays videos in Flutter applications while automatically caching them on Android and iOS devices. The web platform works without caching support, similar to the official video_player plugin.
use_when: You need video playback capabilities with local caching on Android and iOS
You want a drop-in replacement API similar to the official video_player plugin
avoid_when: You need desktop support, as this plugin does not work on Desktop
You need customizable max file and cache sizes on Android, as they are hardcoded
strengths: Supports caching on both Android and iOS
Familiar API based on the official video_player plugin
weaknesses: Hardcoded file and cache limits on Android
Skips caching in iOS if formatHint is set to hls
data.setup_notes: Follow the Android and iOS configuration steps of the official video_player package.

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official video player plugin maintained by the Flutter team, though it lacks built-in caching on mobile.

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Feature-rich audio and video playback solution with advanced controls and platform support.
